audit_notes: Power: observed partial R^2 0.00058 vs MDE 0.00132 at n=5957 (80% power, alpha 0.05) — the design was underpowered for an effect of the observed size; the null result rules out large effects, not small ones.
conclusion_scope: Primary test failed its preregistered criteria (3 of 3 failed; see evidence.verdict_criteria). The rejection is about the preregistered effect at the preregistered threshold, not a claim that no effect of any size exists.

cost_gate.note: Informational only: no costs applied. DGS10 is a yield and is not directly tradable; free proxy series exist (Yahoo ZN=F and IEF) but the DV01/duration conversion and futures roll handling are not modelled, so no clean cost measurement is available. Not a verdict criterion.

limitations: The 2-trading-day BAA10Y publication lag was verified only at fetch time and is assumed constant over the historical sample; FRED's posting schedule may have changed over 2003-2026.
FRED revisions are unmodelled; the trial uses the current vintage, not as-first-posted values.

BAA10Y contains minus DGS10 by definition, so the predictor contains the target's own lag-2 change and the same-day correlation (-0.3863) is mechanical, not evidence of transmission; the baseline's lag-2 guard blocks the channel and the rejection is of the guarded test.
The informational gross sign-rule edge is negative and its confidence interval includes zero; it is descriptive only, on a non-tradable yield, and not a verdict criterion.
The reverse placebo is nominally significant (p=0.0194) but descriptive only, below the 0.005 threshold, and itself mechanically confounded (its target contains minus DGS10).
